name: chemistryuno-mendeleef

scripts.build:backend: node -e "const {execSync} = require('child_process'); process.env.CGO_ENABLED='0'; execSync('go build -o chemistryuno' + (process.platform==='win32'?'.exe':'') + ' main.go', {cwd:'backend', stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.backend: node -e "const {execSync} = require('child_process'); process.env.CGO_ENABLED='0'; execSync('go run main.go', {cwd:'backend', stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.db:init: node -e "const {execSync} = require('child_process'); execSync('go run scripts/init_db.go', {cwd:'backend', stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.tools:init-db: node -e "const {execSync} = require('child_process'); execSync('go run init_db.go', {cwd:'tools', stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.tools:migrate-creds: node -e "const {execSync} = require('child_process'); execSync('go run migrate_credential_ids.go', {cwd:'tools', stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['backend/chemistryuno.db', 'backend/chemistryuno.exe', 'backend/chemistryuno', 'dist'].forEach(f => { try { if (fs.existsSync(f)) { if (fs.statSync(f).isDirectory()) { fs.rmSync(f, {recursive: true}); } else { fs.unlinkSync(f); } } } catch(e) {} })"
scripts.clean:all: pnpm clean && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['frontend/node_modules', 'frontend/dist', 'frontend/.vite'].forEach(f => { try { if (fs.existsSync(f)) { fs.rmSync(f, {recursive: true}); } } catch(e) {} })"

description: Chemistry UNO V1.0.0 Mendeleef - 化学元素版UNO游戏 (正式版)
